subject: social
title: Where I Live
about: The nesting of neighborhood, town, state (North Carolina), country (USA), continent (North America) and planet, plus North Carolina's own geography: Raleigh, the Atlantic coast in the east, mountains in the west, Mount Mitchell and Kitty Hawk. NC 1.G.1.1.
tip: Say 'I live in a town, in a state, in a country' and let him fill in each name.

cards.q: What do we call a group of homes close together where people live?
cards.note: A neighborhood is the homes and streets near where you live.

cards.q: What do we call the people who live near you?
cards.note: Neighbors live in the homes near yours.

cards.q: What do we call a big place with many tall buildings and more people than a town?
cards.note: A city is bigger than a town. Raleigh and Charlotte are cities in North Carolina.

cards.q: What state do we live in?
cards.note: North Carolina is our state. Its state tree is the pine.

cards.q: What country do we live in?
cards.note: The United States is our country. The bald eagle is its national bird.

cards.q: What continent do we live on?
cards.note: North America is one of Earth's seven continents.

cards.q: What planet do we live on?
cards.note: Earth is the planet we all live on. Most of it is covered by water.

cards.q: Which is bigger, a state or a country?
cards.note: A country is made of many states. The United States has 50 states.

cards.q: Which is smaller, a town or a state?
cards.note: Many towns fit inside one state.

cards.q: What is the capital city of North Carolina, where the governor works?
cards.note: Raleigh is the capital. Charlotte is the biggest city in North Carolina, but it is not the capital.

cards.q: Which ocean is at North Carolina's beaches?
cards.note: The Atlantic Ocean is on the east side of North Carolina.

cards.q: Where in North Carolina are the tall mountains?
cards.note: The mountains are in the west, far from the beach.

cards.q: Where in North Carolina are the beaches?
cards.note: The beaches are in the east, next to the Atlantic Ocean.

cards.q: What is the tallest mountain in North Carolina?
cards.note: Mount Mitchell is the tallest mountain east of the Mississippi River.

cards.q: Where in North Carolina did the first airplane fly?
cards.note: The Wright brothers flew the first airplane near Kitty Hawk in 1903.

cards.q: Which state is right above North Carolina, to the north?
cards.note: Virginia is North Carolina's neighbor to the north.

cards.q: Which state is right below North Carolina and shares part of its name?
cards.note: South Carolina is our neighbor to the south.
